correctness.rationale: For N(u),Q(u)>0 from source equation, f′(u)=−2(θ²−1)P(u)/Q(u)² with all-positive P. If θ<1, f increasing prohibits a 2-cycle; if θ=1, f≡1. If θ>1, let g(x)=log f(exp x). The exact polynomial identity NQ−2u(θ²−1)P=R has 16 positive monomials, giving −1<g′(x)<0 all x. Independently expanded and verified this polynomial identity symbolically as zero with SymPy for indeterminates u,θ,θ1, and verified all R coefficients positive. Any distinct x,y with y=g(x), x=g(y) would by MVT give 1=−g′(ξ), contradiction. Hence all positive parameters covered; claim is only the source invariant set v=1 and only 2-cycles.
